Load Structure
Exit Load: (i) If units redeemed or switched
out are upto 10% (limit) of the units
purchased or switched in within 3 months
from the date of allotment – Nil (ii) If units
redeemed or switched out are over and
above the limit within 3 months from the date
of allotment – 1% of the applicable NAV (iii) If
redeemed/switched out after 3 months from
the date of allotment – Nil
